title: AuditEvent
description: Common envelope for a tamper-evident, hash-chained audit record shared across open-security-platform components. Components add their own domain fields (e.g. api_key/model for the AI gateway, actor/target for PAM); the chaining envelope below is constant. Implemented by platform/audit.Chain.

time.description: UTC RFC3339 timestamp of the event.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous record, or the literal "genesis" for the first record.

hash.description: sha256 (hex) over the record's canonical JSON with this field zeroed.
